svg.title: For a finite label set D and root region Y , let FD(Y ) be the sum of Q i∈A pi, pi = fieacB(Xi), over subsets A ⊆D every overlap-connected component of which meets Y . Include the empty subset with weight one. For each component choose one label whose support meets Y , and remove that label from the component. Every component of the remainder meets the removed label’s support. Different original components choose different labels. The chosen labels and the corresponding remainders reconstruct the original subset, so this assignment is injective. Allowing all choices of remainders, including incompatible ones, only increases the sum of nonnegative weights. Therefore
